items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: Well we have Marc Morial to thank as well as Jackie Harris.

ctx.x: I can tell you’ve made a big impression on my wife and myself when we went there. It was over a year ago but—
Well we have Marc Morial to thank as well as Jackie Harris.
But you know you’re arriving there and you’re leaving there and so those are the impressions you get when you arrive and when you leave so that’s terrific.
